human-terse.case: A terse human review with grammar slips and a few mechanical findings.

curly-quotes.case: A clean human review whose only tells are the curly quotes of a word processor.

nonnative-idioms.case: A human review by a non-native writer, with idioms and padding phrases next to grammar slips.

pasted-fields.case: A human review that pastes its weaknesses into the detailed comments.

light-polish.case: A clean review polished by a tool, with restricted words and em-dash glyphs.

ai-written.case: A review written with an AI tool: a formulaic opening, negative parallelism, restatement, and a formulaic closing.

short-dense.case: A short review of two paragraphs, both dense with AI-typical patterns.

mixed-reviewers.case: One submission with three reviews: a human review with slips, an AI-written review, and a clean human review.

ai-with-slips.case: An AI-written review with two typos, whose AI-typical patterns outweigh the slips.
